content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling digital products for crypto is a game-changer for creators in restricted markets. It allows them to tap into a global market, bypassing traditional payment systems. This approach provides infrastructure sovereignty, enabling creators to own and control their commerce stack. With the right tools, creators can deploy a fully functional online store, complete with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture relies on a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, providing a seamless experience for buyers. This stack is designed to be scalable, secure, and easy to maintain, giving creators the freedom to focus on their products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators in restricted markets, such as Kenya, who need a reliable and efficient way to sell their products. It's designed for those who want to maintain control over their commerce infrastructure, without relying on third-party platforms. By using this approach, creators can ensure that they own their customer data, products, and payment processing, providing a level of sovereignty that's essential for long-term success.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides creators with control over their customer data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this commerce stack work together seamlessly, providing a cohesive and efficient experience for both creators and buyers. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages handle hosting, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, and NOWPayments processes crypto payments. This integrated approach ensures that the entire process, from product delivery to payment processing, is automated and secure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the right tools and configuring them according to their needs. They can choose from a range of options, including the Complete Builder Kit, which provides a comprehensive set of tools and templates for building a sovereign commerce infrastructure. By following a step-by-step approach, creators can ensure that their online store is up and running quickly, with minimal technical expertise required.
